newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil seals long-term rig charter.
newsitem.headline: Statoil seals long-term rig charter.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Thursday it had secured an eight-year charter worth just over 2.2 billion crowns for the semi-submersible Borgland Dolphin drilling rig from Dolphin DOC.
After being stacked for almost two years, the unit will be upgraded to begin operations in spring 1998.
The work will include complete rebuilding above the main deck level as well as enlargement and strengthening of the existing support structure.

"A long-term charter for Borgland Dolphin is part of our strategy to secure the rig capacity we need for production and well completion off Norway," said Stein Frode Knudsen in Statoil's drilling and well procurement department.
